name: doc-write
description: Write to the OKF document workspace. Modes: `create` (new document — requires `type`, optional `body`/`frontmatter`), `append` (add content — requires `content` + `expected_version`), `replace` (swap full body — requires `body` + `expected_version`), `section-edit` (replace a `##` section's body — requires `section`, `content`), `section-delete` (remove a `##` section and its heading — requires `section`; errors if missing). Section modes take optional `expected_section_version`. Each write appends to the directory's `log.md`. On version mismatch returns `conflict: true` with the latest versions — re-read and retry. **Retention:** `/projects/…` is durable. `/scratch/<conversation-id>/…` is ephemeral — omit `ttl_days` for the scratch TTL, `ttl_days: <n>` overrides, `0` opts out. `ttl_days` elsewhere is ignored (returns a `retention_warning`).

inputs.type: string? (required for create — OKF frontmatter type)
inputs.body: string? (required for replace; optional for create)
inputs.frontmatter: object? (optional YAML frontmatter fields except type; `ttl_days` controls scratch retention — omit to inherit default, 0 to opt out)
inputs.expected_version: number? (required for append/replace — from last doc-read)
inputs.summary: string? (one-line description for log.md — defaults to mode + path)
inputs.task_id: string? (optional — defaults to the project-root task id of the bound task)

outputs.retention_warning: string? (when ttl_days is set on a non-scratch path)
